description: Kanbanz by Softaculous plugin for WordPress versions before 1.0.3 has a broken access control vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated Kanban Staff users to access and modify boards they do not belong to by exploiting admin-ajax handlers that do not properly enforce access checks. Attackers can manipulate board_id or task_id parameters to read sensitive data, modify task details, inject comments, and manage attachments on unauthorized boards.
